purpose: Canonical debt IDs seeded from P2 repository-control masterplan gaps with ownership, risk, backlog and ADR disposition.

policy.ownership: Every debt item has a canonical accountability owner.
policy.backlog: Every debt item links exactly to its canonical backlog gap item.
policy.adr: Each item either names an ADR or explicitly states why no ADR is yet required; architecture-changing retirement requires ADR.
policy.retirement: Debt retirement cannot bypass compatibility, migration, rollback, tests or signed verification.
